purpose: synthetic developmental evaluation; parser designed around the supported fixture grammar; not authentic held-out real supplier validation

dataset_audit.method: max(word 5-shingle Jaccard, token sequence ratio for pages <=2000 tokens); exact normalized equality at any length

manifest_description: Synthetic developmental evaluation, not authentic held-out supplier validation

metric_definitions.exact_part_date_relationship_accuracy: multiset intersection / multiset union of exact (raw part, date type, normalized date-or-null) tuples; extras and missing tuples reduce score
metric_definitions.critical_omissions: missing part records + missing date relationships + missing annotated exceptions + missing revision relationships (categories can overlap)
metric_definitions.unsupported_assertions: extra part/date/revision assertions against gold + annotated exception scope leaks + missing/broken critical evidence (categories can overlap)
metric_definitions.evidence_localization: exact page-local Unicode slice equality across all returned citations; does not prove semantic entailment
metric_definitions.review_required_coverage: expected uncertain parts that have a part/date review_required flag
metric_definitions.null_metrics: null means no applicable gold cases or predictions, not perfect performance

hardware.memory_measurement: process lifetime high-water RSS; includes interpreter and prior work

cost.utilization: serial on this shared host; no dedicated capacity assumption
